title: Beyond the frontier: Pragmatic AI risk management for the rest of us
headline: Pragmatic AI risk management for businesses adopting off-the-shelf tools
summary: This article discusses practical AI risk management for the majority of businesses that license off-the-shelf AI products rather than building models. It highlights the challenges organisations face due to a lack of in-house AI expertise, an inability to vet black box systems, and a lack of negotiating leverage with vendors. The author addresses the guidance gap in major governance frameworks, which typically target developers and organisations with substantial control over model behaviour.
why_it_matters: Organisations adopting third-party AI tools must navigate vendor-imposed commercial terms and limited bargaining power when implementing risk management frameworks.

quotes.text: The reality is that 99% of businesses are not building their own AI models. They are mostly licensing off-the-shelf LLMs and other AI products at the mercy of commercial terms set by AI vendors.
What realistic and pragmatic steps can an average business take to manage its AI risks?

classification.significance_reason: Provides general commentary on AI risk management challenges for non-developer businesses without introducing new legal or regulatory obligations.
